response.answer: Success rates dipped on 17 September: 87.29% (10,085 of 11,554 attempts), versus a steady ~89.5-90.4% in the preceding week (10-16 Sept). That is roughly a 3-point drop from the 90.35% seen on 15 and 16 Sept. The dip continued on 18 Sept (86.66%, the lowest in the window) before recovering to 89.79% on 19 Sept and ~90% afterwards. Volumes were normal on both days (about 11.5k and 11.2k attempts), so this looks like a genuine two-day decline in success rate rather than a volume effect. The data doesn't show the cause; breaking down by failure reason, payment method, issuer or acquirer for 17-18 Sept would be the next step.
